# Spaceezy

> Spaceezy is a real-estate firm that helps buyers discover, shortlist and enquire about residential properties and builder projects. Its website publishes project and unit information with current prices, configurations and availability.

This file expands on `llms.txt` with verified, public-facing information only. It does not describe private dashboards, admin pages, APIs or internal documentation.

## About the business

Spaceezy was founded with the stated mission of making the journey of finding a home more transparent. The About page describes curated options, honest advice and end-to-end support for buyers looking at homes and projects.

Publicly stated service points:

- Zero brokerage on partner and new developer projects.
- Dedicated relationship managers for site visits.
- Legal and documentation assistance.
- Post-sales support.
- Listings are described as verified, and project pages show RERA registration details where available.

Leadership listed publicly: Gaurav Sharma (Chief Executive Officer) and Kamal (Founder).

Spaceezy uses an internal CRM to keep enquiries, inventory, follow-ups and site visits coordinated. This is an operational system, not a software product marketed to the public.

## Property categories currently published

- Builder projects: residential developments with configuration, pricing, amenities, RERA and availability details.
- Individual residential units: flats with area, price, configuration and availability status.
- Location collections: residential listings grouped by published place and type, currently Wave City and 1 BHK flats in Wave City.

The CRM data model supports additional purpose values, but no resale or rental listings are published on the public website at this time. No seller-service page is published.

## Areas served

The website and company details list Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh as the served area. The published projects and the office are located there. Separate city doorway pages are not published.

- [Property buying assistance](https://spaceezy.com/property-buying-assistance): How discovery, shortlisting, enquiries, site visits and documentation support work for buyers.

- [Site visits](https://spaceezy.com/site-visits): How to request a visit, where properties are and what to prepare.

- [Dream Homes](https://spaceezy.com/projects/dream-homes-e84e51): Residential project in Wave City, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, by Wave Group, with 1 BHK, 2 BHK and 3 BHK configurations and RERA information.
